summary: The Yoga Session for the teachers at Rishi Valmiki Eco School was successfully conducted on 3rd October by our very own Rotary Ann Chaitali Prabhu.
description:
The Yoga Session for the teachers at Rishi Valmiki Eco School was successfully conducted on 3rd October by our very own Rotary Ann Chaitali Prabhu.

It was a wonderful initiative by the Interactors, and the teachers thoroughly enjoyed the session.

Thank you, Chaitali, for making it so meaningful.
